title: Victoria Corner Ladies Ready for Boyer's Island, 1908
description: The Victoria Corner ladies dressed and prepared to boat to Boyer's Island, where they would tend their gardens and take what they needed from nature. They used scythes to cut hay. Potatoes were dug up with forks and hands. The produce was loaded into small hand wagons and carried slowly in order to load a flat-bottom handcrafted boat.
